Swim CSS Calculator

Critical swim speed from your 400 m and 200 m time trials, plus training zones.

–
CSS / 100 m

For information only — not medical advice.

📖 How to use

  1. Swim an all-out 400 m time trial and record the time.
  2. Rest, then swim an all-out 200 m time trial and record it.
  3. Enter both as mm:ss.
  4. Read your CSS pace per 100 m and the training zone paces around it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is critical swim speed?

The fastest pace you can theoretically hold aerobically, estimated here as (400m time minus 200m time) divided by 2, per 100 m.

Why must the 400 m be slower per 100 m than the 200 m?

If it is not, at least one trial was not a true maximal effort, and the estimate is invalid.

How do I use the zones?

Train mostly at CSS plus a few seconds (aerobic), touch CSS pace for threshold sets, and go faster for sprint work.
